learning_outcomes.text: Student knows the basic concept of Sustainable Development.
Student knows some instruments for SD, international documents of environmental protection and some aspects of environmental policy.
Student uses English sufficiently to communicate, also in matters of professional and technical, can prepare and show a short presentation on the sustainable tasks.

syllabus_topics: Historical background and concepts: The UN process - from Stockholm to Johannesburg. Understanding sustainable development
Energy and Climate: Energy use and Climate change. Energy management strategies
Resources: Limits to Growth - How long will the World’s natural resources last?
Production & Consumption: Consumption – sustainable use of products.
Life, Food and Fibres: The living world. Land and water. Agriculture and food. Forests and fibres.
Mobility: Means of mobility – technology and systems. Freight. Policies and management of mobility.
Welfare & Life Style: Social sustainability, happiness and the one-planet-life.
Politics: Making and implementing sustainable development politics.
Economics: Economy and ecology – a single system. The dilemma of economic growth. Tools for approaching a sustainable economy.
Change: The processes of individual change. Teaching sustainable development - A guide for teachers. Managing change
assessment_rules: The written exam assesses learning outcomes 1 and 2, while the presentation assesses learning outcome 3.
